notes.text: The alternative to Rabbi Guryon is Rav Yosef bar Rabbi Shemayah in the checked witness.
Rabbi Guryon reports Rabbi Yose ben Chanina about redeeming sacred food.
The independent Nazir report gives the same transmission formula.
Rabbi Guryon reports the question the people of Magdala asked Resh Lakish.
The Yerushalmi explicitly records Rabbi Yonah visiting Rabbi Guryon.
The statement to Rav Pappa remains without a secure locus. The separately checked Bavli and Yerushalmi chains do not identify this connection, and the targeted phrase search was negative.
